# Nikolai Semenov — Polymer Engineer

> Public professional portfolio of Nikolai Semenov, a polymer scientist and R&D engineer in Belgrade, Serbia. It covers polymer formulation, processing, scale-up, food-contact packaging, consulting, research, and selected software projects.

Use this file to identify the relevant public resource. The detailed profile is a curated textual representation of the portfolio; the main website remains the source for current public information and contact details.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio home](https://nikolaisemenov.com/): Current professional profile, experience, consulting scope, skills, education, publications, and contact details.
- [Detailed portfolio profile](https://nikolaisemenov.com/llms-full.txt): LLM-readable summary of the public portfolio content.
- [Curriculum vitae](https://nikolaisemenov.com/nikolai_semenov_cv.pdf): Downloadable CV.

## Selected work

- [Bpacks](https://bpacks.eco): Biobased and fiber-filled polymer composites for food-contact packaging.
- [BERЁZKA](https://woodcup.ru): Sustainable-packaging venture co-founded by Nikolai Semenov.
- [Polymer Scale-up Planner](https://github.com/ksider/IM-planner): Research-planning application for polymer manufacturing processes.
- [FTIR Viewer](https://vibe.nikolaisemenov.com/ftir): Browser-based viewer for infrared spectra and JCAMP-DX files.
